intro.en: Holiday words, and telling someone how your holiday went.

la montaña.en: the mountain; the mountains (as a region)

hacer la maleta.en: to pack a suitcase; to pack for a trip
hacer la maleta.pron: a-SER la ma-LE-ta (seseo) / a-THER la ma-LE-ta (distinción)

bañarse.en: to bathe, to go for a swim

texto.en:
The question is **¿Qué tal las vacaciones?**

To describe a completed holiday, give a short opinion and then details in the pretérito indefinido (simple past).

- opinion: **¡Genial!**, **Muy bien**, **Regular**, **Fatal** or **Lo pasé** muy bien.
- where: **fui a** la playa; **estuve en** la montaña; **nos alojamos en** un hotel.
- what you did: **tomamos** el sol, **nos bañamos**, **hicimos** una excursión.
- weather: **hizo** buen tiempo; **llovió** todos los días.

The **nosotros** forms **tomamos** and **nos bañamos** look the same in the present and past; here the holiday context makes the past meaning clear. In the dialogue, **hicisteis** is the informal plural used in Spain; in much of Latin America and in formal plural address in Spain, use **hicieron**.

With **gustar** and **encantar**, the verb agrees with the thing liked: me **gustó** la playa / me **gustaron** las playas; me **encantó** la excursión / me **encantaron** las playas.

You go **de vacaciones**, and you **haces la maleta** before leaving.

frases.es: ¡Genial! Fuimos a la playa y nos alojamos en un camping.
frases.en: Great! We went to the beach and stayed at a campsite.

frases.es: Sí. Tomamos el sol y nos bañamos todos los días.
frases.en: Yes. We sunbathed and went swimming every day.
Did you go on any trips?

frases.es: Sí, hicimos una excursión a la montaña. Me encantó. Lo pasamos muy bien.
frases.en: Yes, we went on an excursion to the mountains. I loved it. We had a very good time.

gustó.en: La playa is one thing, so use the singular gustó.

gusté.en: The verb agrees with the beach.

pregunta.en: Complete: we had a very good time.
Complete: we stayed in a hotel.
Complete: The weather was nice yesterday.

hizo.en: The past expression is hizo buen tiempo.

estuvo.en: For this weather expression, use hizo.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (60–80 words).** Write a postcard or message about a finished holiday: where you went, what you did and what the weather was like.

**Speak (about 1 minute).** Tell someone about the best holiday of your life.
